description: This file defines ASN.1 NGAP protocol structures, including message types, procedures, and containers for 3GPP TS ASN1 NGAP v18.8.0 (2025-12). It includes class and struct definitions for NGAP PDUs, procedures, and protocol information elements, with references to external utility headers.

classes.name: ngap_pdu_c
classes.description: A choice structure representing NGAP Protocol Data Units, which can be initiation, success, or failure messages.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an NGAP initiating message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful NGAP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a failed NGAP message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: ngap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Object set defining various NGAP elementary procedures, including request, response, and failure types.

classes.name: protocol_ie_field_pair_s
classes.description: Template struct for protocol information element field pairs, including serialization and JSON conversion.

methods.name: set()
methods.description: Sets the type of the NGAP message or procedure.

methods.name: pack()
methods.description: Serializes the message or procedure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack()
methods.description: Deserializes the message or procedure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json()
methods.description: Converts the message or procedure to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj()
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
